title: AL Language extension for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central – versions
summary: AL Language extension changelog documenting features added across versions 15.0 through 18.0, including implicit type conversions, HTTP mocking in tests, multiline strings, JSON accessors, AppSourceCop rules, namespace documentation, and improved IDE capabilities in Visual Studio Code.
key_points: Support for implicit conversion between Record and RecordRef types simplifies type handling
HTTP client mocking via HttpClientHandler allows testing external service integrations without actual requests
Namespace support with documentation and ALDoc improvements enables better code organization and documentation
New JSON methods (GetBoolean, GetText, etc.) provide direct access to JSON properties without JsonToken intermediaries
Extended AppSourceCop and PerTenantExtensionCop rules validate field classification, breaking changes, and namespace uniqueness

quotes.text: We have introduced support for implicit conversion between Record and RecordRef instances, allowing direct assignment between these types.
quotes.why_it_matters: Simplifies code by eliminating boilerplate conversion calls, improving developer productivity and code readability

quotes.text: This feature allows for more controlled and easier testing of modules that interact with external services.
quotes.why_it_matters: HTTP mocking enables isolated unit testing without dependency on external APIs, critical for reliable CI/CD pipelines

quotes.text: AL now has support for multiline string literals. A multiline string must be prefixed with @.
quotes.why_it_matters: Multiline strings enable developers to include formatted text and JSON payloads directly in code without escape sequences
